description:
Problem: v0.5.0 was pinned with `--from` after verification by an older verifier, because the current verifier rejects that bundle. The default path of `npm run docs:pin -- vX.Y.Z` (child bundle-fetch with full verification, then the pin swap) has only been exercised up to the expected verification failure and through an injected fetch in tests. Outcome: the first release after v0.5.0 is pinned by the default path, and the release procedure in AGENTS.md is proven end to end.

At the next published core release: run `npm run docs:pin -- <tag>` on next by pull request, open the next into main pull request, merge on green ci, then merge main into next.
